question: A warehouse starts with 216 boxes. It adds 15 (231). It adds 77 (308). It multiplies by 5 (1540). It multiplies by 5 (7700). It divides by 2 (3850). It loses 1610 (2240). How many boxes?
A stock starts with 155 shares. It adds 66 (221). It adds 23 (244). It loses 43 (201). It loses 71 (130). Time: minutes to hours noted. How many shares?
Ken and Lily run a shop. They start with 122 items. They add 42 (164). They lose 6 (158). They multiply by 3 (474). They add 7 (481). They lose 168 (313). How many items?
A library starts with 106 books. In the morning, it multiplies by 4 (424). By afternoon, it adds 69 (493). By evening, 384 are checked out (109). By closing, 93 are removed (16). How many books?

A storage starts with 237 items. Through the day: loses 182 (55), adds 11 (66), loses 24 (42), adds 10 (52), loses 10 (42), adds 66 (108). The quantity transitions through all stages. One distractor: budget was 88. How many items?

A farm starts with 110 animals. It loses 48 (62). It loses 20 (42). It multiplies by 6 (252). It multiplies by 3 (756). It adds 31 (787). Double of 18 is 36. Bbb has 500. How many animals?
